title: Outpost Assault: how to play
sections: Waves of enemies march towards your outpost. Stop them before they reach it: every enemy that gets in damages the outpost, and when its health is gone you lose. Survive all three waves to win.
Tap an empty turret slot to open the build menu, then tap a turret to buy it. Turrets fire on their own at enemies in range; while a turret is selected its range is shown.

Gatling (250): very fast small bullets, hits infantry and tanks. Single-shot (400): one heavy shell every few seconds, tanks only. Missile (800): homing missiles against helicopters only. You need missile turrets before the helicopters arrive.
Every enemy you destroy pays money. Tap a turret you built to repair it (you pay for the damage) or to remove it (you get back half its value, less if it is damaged).
Drag with one finger to move the map, pinch or use + and - to zoom, II pauses. On a PC: click, drag with the middle mouse button, scroll wheel to zoom, Esc to pause.
Put gatlings where the enemy path bends, so they stay in range longer. Spend your first money on gatlings, then add single-shots for tanks and missiles for helicopters. Repair turrets between waves.
